objective.text: Study the ignition, flame growth, flame spread, and extinction limits for solid fuels burning in low-velocity forced flows in microgravity.
objective.quote: Study the ignition, flame growth, flame spread, and extinction limits for solid fuels burning in low-velocity forced flows in microgravity.

fuel.text: Solid fuels are burned in the tests.
fuel.quote: Study the ignition, flame growth, flame spread, and extinction limits for solid fuels burning in low-velocity forced flows in microgravity.

sample_geometry.text: Practical, realistic (thicker) fuels in typical geometries will be examined, including slabs, cylinders, and spherical sections.
sample_geometry.quote: Practical, realistic (thicker) fuels in typical geometries will be examined, including slabs, cylinders, and spherical sections.

flow.text: Fuel samples were mounted inside a small wind tunnel which could impose airflow speeds up to 40 cm/s.
flow.quote: Fuel samples were mounted inside a small wind tunnel which could impose airflow speeds up to 40 cm/s.

variables.text: The primary variables include Forced flow velocity (speed and direction).
variables.quote:
The primary variables include:
     • Forced flow velocity (speed and direction)

measurements.text: Flame appearance, flame growth, and spread rates were determined in both the opposed and concurrent flow.
measurements.quote: Flame appearance, flame growth, and spread rates were determined in both the opposed and concurrent flow.

safety_finding.text: BASS-II helps engineers select the safest materials and improve firefighting methods on future space missions.
safety_finding.quote: BASS-II helps engineers select the safest materials and improve firefighting methods on future space missions.

earth_benefits.text: These models can then be used to more accurately study flames on Earth, such as in wildfires, building fires, energy recapture from waste recycling, and other combustion problems.
earth_benefits.quote: These models can then be used to more accurately study flames on Earth, such as in wildfires, building fires, energy recapture from waste recycling, and other combustion problems.
